text: Could you make a clip that starts with a dark green title card with cream lettering, then cuts to a slow moving shot of a misty mountain lake at sunrise? I’ve been craving a little moment of calm, which is why this idea appeals to me. The title should say exactly “A quieter kind of morning,” with that capitalization and without the quotation marks or the comma, and stay on screen for the first 2 seconds. The whole clip should be 6 seconds long, in 16:9 widescreen, and completely silent. I’m probably over-explaining because I’m excited about how peaceful it could feel. Please don’t include any other text; the title’s font and layout are your call.
